author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat: wolf doctrine takes the belt — AKELA 2-1 VERONICA (arena 89)

The sixth doctrine attacks the axis no brain had touched: TEAMWORK.
Every duel-optimized engine plays three independent 1v1s; the wolf pack
plays one 3v1. All wolves deterministically agree on a single prey
(lowest health among enemies visible to ANY packmate — shared eyes, no
communication channel, agreement by convention on a shared retarget
clock), take crossfire bearings (left/right/above by position and
index), and regroup when isolated.

Lessons paid for in sparring: a wolf parked on its bearing is target
practice (juke in the slot); a wolf that ignores its attacker while
walking to the slot donates free damage (the gun goes opportunistic
when the prey is out of reach); wounded prey beyond PREY_RADIUS must
not drag the pack past healthy guns.

Official: 36-34, 43-39, 35-38 on arena #89.
Dataset: 20260610-054754-AKELA-wolf-vs-VERONICA-matador

feat: THE CLAUDE ARENA — fighter cards, watchable fights, generated maps, true team colors

THE INTERFACE (ARENA.md is the login): a coach — Claude Fable instance,
human, or future model wrapper — grabs a brain and files a FIGHTER CARD
(soldat-fighter-card/1: coach, engine, tweaks, rationale; validation errors
list the legal knobs so coaches self-serve). Two cards fight:

  pnpm arena fight fights/vega.json fights/okonkwo.json --matches 3 --arena 7

Every match records a training dataset AND prints a WATCH URL — the sim is
deterministic per seed, so the browser REPLAYS the exact recorded match:
coach names on the banner ('PILOT (VEGA) vs REAPER (OKONKWO)'), each side's
knob turns on the info card (?tweak-a/?tweak-b/?coach-a/?coach-b parsed in
main.ts and threaded into Game.engineTweaks).

GENERATED MAPS ('we can't just play one'): generateArena(seed) rolls
deterministic Skyreach-family layouts (sealed aerial box, rejection-sampled
perch pads, spread spawns) — ?arena=N in the browser, --arena N in the CLI,
arenaSeed in MatchConfig, and tournament tiles each play a different map
per generation. Seed 0 = the canonical hand-built Skyreach. Same seed =
byte-identical map, so manifests stay reproducible.

TRUE TEAM COLORS (user report, twice): only the shirt/pants texture slots
were team-tinted and dark camo ate the tint. Every non-skin Gostek part now
carries a bright team wash — soldiers finally READ red vs blue at any zoom.

(reaper, the match-4 closer config) on arena #7 — the config that won the

feat(ai): third engine — reaper, the dive brawler built to counter pilot

Pilot wins by holding a 200-420px range band with a height edge. Reaper
denies the band: relentless gap-close with an rng-jittered run-in, approach

knife-range commitment (full-auto inside 180px, push THROUGH the target,
reload only on a dry mag), 5s hunt memory, same ceiling-stall give-up as

under 320px and ate free tap-bursts on the run-in — pilot swept 4-0

pilot's preferred edge), commits at 180px: round went 3-1 with one game
DECIDED ON TIEBREAK (16-16), two others by 2 kills, and reaper WON the
marksman variant 13-11. The meta has its first real rivalry.

reaper registers like any engine: ?ai=reaper, ?duel=pilot,reaper,
?tournament&ai=pilot,reaper, E-cycle. 439 tests green.

feat: swappable bot-AI engines (adapter) + ?duel side-by-side engine matches

The line in the sand (decision node 136): every bot brain now lives behind
one adapter seam — BotEngine/BotBrain in client/src/ai/ with a name registry.
Game takes aiEngine ('classic'|'pilot'|any registered id; unknown falls back

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(client): spectate mode — bot-vs-bot matches with broadcast director camera

?spectate (or ?spectate=N, 2-12 bots, default 6): a self-sustaining bot
deathmatch with no human soldier, an action camera, and a live scoreboard —
built to watch and judge the gameplay.

- Kill attribution: sim Sprite.lastHitBy (set on every damaging hit) +
  Game.onKill fired exactly once on the death edge; suicides/unattributed
  excluded from tallies
- Director (new director.ts, pure tested core): scores subjects by kill
  heat > firing > enemy proximity; 3.5s min dwell + hysteresis stops
  whiplash; dead subject cuts immediately, preferring its killer; arrows/N/P
  cycle bots manually, A/0 returns to auto; lerped broadcast pan with
  snap-cuts past 1500px

  leader/runner-up scores, real kill feed
- Bot sustainment (spectate-gated): alpha=255 so bots can SEE each other —
  discovered normal-mode bots are pacifists today (findTarget skips
  alpha!==255 and nothing ever set alpha; promoting the fix to play mode is
  a deliberate follow-up) — plus absolute->relative bot aim conversion,
  real .PMS waypoint adoption, deterministic roam fallback with stuck
  jump/jet pulses
- Normal play byte-for-byte unchanged (every change spectate-gated;
  browser-regression verified)

Verified: 380/380 tests (26 new: director rules, kill board, 10k-tick match
sustainment, play-mode regression, sim lastHitBy); two 90s headless-Chrome

Three bugs, one shape: a later force assignment stomping a stronger upward
force on the same tick (faithful to Pascal's assignment order, wrong for us):
- Jump + jet: jet ground-kick (-0.25) OVERWROTE the jump force (-0.66) —
  holding Shift while jumping nerfed the jump to a hop
- Running takeoff: ground movement overwrote jet lift with -RUNSPEEDUP
  (0.0197, below gravity 0.06) — you could never lift off while running
- Running jump: Pascal side-jump vertical is 0.25 vs 0.66 standing — ~1/3
  the height, i.e. 'I cant jump over basic land obstacles'. Side-jumps now
  keep 90% of the straight jump's vertical plus the horizontal kick

Ground forceY now combines via most-upward-wins (min of negatives) in the
movement branches and the jet kick; all marked DESIGN OVERRIDE (node 100).
3 new regression tests (jump-with-jet >= jump, running takeoff climbs,
side-jump > 0.7x straight jump). 347 tests green.

This is a VERY vertical game; the boots should rocket you UP, not sideways.
First deliberate DESIGN OVERRIDE of the faithful Pascal constants (decision
node 94, marked in code):
- JET_THRUST 0.1 -> 0.18 (net lift vs gravity triples: 0.04 -> 0.12)
- While the jet burns, lateral air force halves (JET_AIR_DRIFT = FLYSPEED/2)
  so boosting reads as up + steer; full air control returns when fuel is dry
- Fuel 250 -> 700 ticks (~11.7 s burn) + on-ground regen (3/tick, empty->full
  ~3.9 s) for player and bots — jets gate engagements, not movement
- Jet HUD bar fixed: was jetsCountReal (never decremented) over a hardcoded
  max of 100; now live jetsCount over JET_FUEL_MAX

beat 1.5x horizontal drift while jetting) and dry-tank air-control restore.

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(client): keyboard-only controls — WASD move, IJKL aim, Space fire, Tab reload

The game is now fully playable with no mouse. IJKL drive a persistent aim
angle emitted through the unchanged Control.mouseAimX/Y offset contract:
dt-based two-phase rotation (3 rad/s fine-nudge for 80ms after each chord
change, then 14 rad/s swing) toward 8 octant targets, exact settle, instant
elevation-preserving mirror-flip for turnarounds, ±1px vertical-aim facing
bias. Space fires (W/Up is jump), Tab reloads (preventDefault on both key
events so focus never moves), Shift stays jetpack. Mouse remains optional:
3px-accumulated mousemove reclaims aim, any IJKL keydown takes it back
seeded from the last offset so the crosshair never jumps. Window blur now
clears all held keys (fixes latent stuck-key bug for ALL bindings).

Verified: typecheck + 339 tests green (20 new input tests); live headless-
Chrome CDP playtest with zero mouse events — movement, jump/jet, all aim
chords + persistence, ammo drain 30->21 on held Space, Tab reload, focus
retained after Tab. Multi-agent workflow: 3-lens design + judge, implement,
3-verifier adversarial check, 1 fix round.
